v07-01-r2.reason: Three-year average performance can establish 2025 compliance. Sole determination by mass contradicts dependence partly on mass; individual vehicle limits are explicitly rejected. The electric-sales explanation is unstated.

v07-02-r2.reason: The option now excludes service exemptions and prior delay notice. An own-staff strike does not remove compensation, and 25% of €80 is €20, above the maximum €4 minimum threshold. Assistance and rerouting remain due; exemptions concern specified service categories and parts of the regulation.

v08-05-r2.reason: Triggering the national-law presumption shifts the contrary burden to the platform. The distribution of platform workers by activity is unstated, automatic employee reclassification is explicitly denied, and the human-decision requirement concerns significant decisions rather than every decision.
